policy: The October 16 pass deleted the request-context surfaces that showed the admission snapshot as UI: the Context panel ("Directions for this request" with the input version, earlier words and "Project instructions · version N"), its only screen C12, the "Inputs and directions" sheet with "Review directions" on C24, and a hidden note about copied directions on M08. Do not redraw them. The composer already shows the inputs and words a request will send; Reuse setup restores an earlier setup from the History menu, the viewer's Use menu and W37. The exact context stays an immutable backend snapshot. The Project menu's "Project instructions" item opened nothing and was removed too, so project instructions have no UI. Later the same day, the Download status component (idle, resolving, started, failed), its review board and E37 "Export download started" were deleted. Download hands the file to the browser, which shows the transfer, so the app draws no download status, and E36's Download button no longer links to another screen. The Dialog component was deleted too: it had no instances, its three kinds showed the same copy, and the leave guards (R04, B42, K18) draw their own dialogs. The same day the Clarification component lost its answering, proposal_ready, stale_proposal, applied and dismissed variants and its Review / Clarification board. Studio sends a chosen quick pick as the next message, so those lifecycle cards never appear; only the question card (now State=Default, used twice on C16) remains. Do not redraw them. Later on October 16 the Request status component (queued, running, succeeded, partial, failed), its Review / Request status board, its one screen use beside C09's result grid and C30's copied "2 ready · 1 failed · 1 still running" line were deleted. Each output slot already shows its own state (In the queue, Making your image, a ready result, or Could not make this image with Try again), and video requests keep their one-line status in conversation history, so the card only repeated the slots. Its Cancel and Cancel remaining buttons had no server route or UI control behind them, and View results pointed at results already on screen. The Project card component (local, creating, ready, load_failed, inaccessible, trashing, trashed) was deleted with it: no screen used it, and the server's project status is only active or trashed. Do not redraw them. W14 ("Cancel this generation?") was deleted after that: with the card's Cancel buttons gone nothing in the design opened it, and the app has no cancel route or control. Cancellation stays an internal contract; do not redraw a cancel dialog. Later on October 16, C16 ("Answer a specific question") and the Clarification component (its last variant, State=Default) were deleted. C16 showed the workspace answering "Use the second one." with image choices ("Which image should I change?"). The project workspace never asks a clarifying question, and Studio's first-turn clarify is a text question with quick-pick buttons, not an image chooser. Do not redraw them. Later on October 16, G13 ("An audio reference is an input, not a music track") and G14 ("Audio reference limits block an invalid input") were deleted with their two composer media shelves, and G12 and G24 lost their Audio action. They drew an audio reference input for Wan 2.5, but its profile accepts only a start frame and the adapter drops audio references, so no current model produces them. G13/G14 were also the last screens with the 336px compact composer floating outside a Conversation panel. The Input tile State=Audio attached variant lost its only use and was deleted. Do not redraw audio-reference input until a profile accepts it. Composer settings pass (Bryce approved the mockups): the icon-only ··· chip opened Model settings / Video settings popovers that repeated the chips beside them (3 of 4 and 5 of 6 rows) plus a Seed row no capability profile supports. The chip, both components, C55, C56 and their links were deleted; each chip opens its own Menu (C03 Images, C23 Duration, B13 Shape sheet). An unavailable model shows on its own chip (Setting chip State=Invalid) with one Field error in Composer controls (Show error); C14 lost its viewer notice and the line baked into its prompt content. The fixed "1 video" chip was dropped because video makes one clip, and "audio on" became "Sound on". Do not reintroduce an overflow settings menu, a seed control or count chips that cannot change. Page 07 follow-up: the hand-built Duration, Aspect ratio, Resolution and Video models menus (G03, G04, G05, G22) were replaced by Menu and Model picker instances without headers. Menu item gained Caption + Show caption (12/16 text/secondary) for second lines such as "8 seconds required", and Menu gained a Row 3 boolean for two-option menus. G-series chips now follow the composer order used elsewhere (model, shape, duration, resolution, sound, then Advanced) with one glyph per role: ratio for shape, clock for duration, sliders-horizontal for resolution. Veo shape chips show a chevron except on G29, where an extension inherits its shape. Later the same day Bryce asked whether every auth state on page 14 was needed. 39 of the 54 desktop auth screens and their 39 mobile twins on page 16 were deleted: they repeated a kept screen with different words, showed a form with text typed in, or drew a state that cannot happen. The Check verification action and its result screens went too. See authStatePruning. Later on October 16 Bryce asked what "In the queue" meant on C49. It was the server's queued job status: accepted, not yet started on the model. Every queued screen matched its running twin except for that line, so C40, C49, E34, W06 and W54, Output State=Waiting, Export panel State=Queued and the unused Output Received, Saving, Stored and Lost variants were deleted, and E32's Export now opens E35. Do not redraw queued, waiting or saving states. See queueStatePruning.
